_readme: Inclusion Festival & Resource Fair — the shop list.
This file IS the editable source. To add or change a shop, edit it here and
commit; the site picks it up on the next deploy. The admin page at
/InclusionFestival/admin generates the whole file so nobody hand-edits JSON.
dropping new ones in, to square and shrink them.
PUNCH CODES ARE DELIBERATELY NOT IN THIS FILE. It ships to every browser, and
a readable code would let an attendee stamp their own card in front of staff.
Codes exist only in Supabase, minted when you press Publish on the admin page.
"simulated": true marks a shop that is NOT a real business — a worked example
so the card can be tested end to end before the first Mountain House shops
sign up. Simulated shops are labelled in amber everywhere they appear, on the
tile, in the offer dialog and above the card. Delete the flag when a real
business takes that spot; that is the only edit needed.
settings.state here is only what the page paints BEFORE the database answers.
The real switch is Supabase festival_settings.state, set from the Festival
stage buttons on the admin page. Keep this matching reality at deploy time so
the first paint never invites anyone to a door that is shut.
